title: MQ-8C Fire Scout Conducts Night Flight
description:
220106-N-HD110-1502
CARIBBEAN SEA - (Jan. 6, 2022) -- An MQ-8C Fire Scout attached to the “Sea Knights” of Helicopter Sea Combat Squadron (HSC) 22, Detachment 5, conducts night flight operations from the flight deck of the Freedom-variant littoral combat ship USS Milwaukee (LCS 5), Jan. 6, 2022. Milwaukee is deployed to the U.S. 4th Fleet area of operations to support Joint Interagency Task Force South’s mission, which includes counter-illicit drug trafficking missions in the Caribbean and Eastern Pacific. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Danielle Baker/Released)
